scenarios.title: Each generic mana of a waterbend cost can be paid by tapping an artifact or creature

setup.notes: A controls no lands. All Grizzly Bears are untapped. Library is listed top first.

decisions: A activates Aang's Iceberg's ability (waterbend {3}: sacrifice it, then scry 2), paying the {3} by tapping the Grizzly Bears A controls.
Both players pass; the ability resolves. A looks at Forest and Mountain and keeps both on top.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: The activation is legal: tapping three Grizzly Bears pays the {3}. Aang's Iceberg is sacrificed and moves to A's graveyard, and the three Grizzly Bears are tapped.

variants.label: too_few_creatures
variants.delta: A controls only two Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: The activation is not legal: two tapped creatures pay only {2} of the {3} and A has no mana. Aang's Iceberg stays on the battlefield and both Grizzly Bears stay untapped.

variants.label: mixed_payment
variants.delta: A controls two Grizzly Bears and one untapped Plains.
variants.expected: The activation is legal: two Grizzly Bears are tapped and the Plains is tapped for {W} to pay the rest of the {3}. Aang's Iceberg is sacrificed.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge handles waterbend in CostAdjustment with the convoke and improvise helper, limited to the waterbend amount.

scenarios.title: A waterbend additional cost lets creatures pay only its own generic mana

setup.notes: Spirit Water Revival costs {1}{U}{U} with an optional additional cost of waterbend {6}. All seven Grizzly Bears are untapped.

decisions: A attempts to cast Spirit Water Revival, paying the optional waterbend {6} by tapping six Grizzly Bears and the {1}{U}{U} with the lands A controls and the seventh Grizzly Bear.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: The cast is not legal: the seventh Grizzly Bear cannot pay for the {1} of the spell's own mana cost, so the {1}{U}{U} is short one mana. Spirit Water Revival stays in A's hand and nothing is tapped.

variants.label: third_land
variants.expected: The cast is legal: six Grizzly Bears pay the waterbend {6} and the three Islands pay the {1}{U}{U}. One Grizzly Bear stays untapped. Spirit Water Revival goes on the stack with its additional cost paid.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge limits waterbend payment through the maximum waterbend amount set on the spell ability.

scenarios.title: Waterbending triggers however the cost was paid

setup.notes: Avatar Aang has 'Whenever you waterbend, earthbend, firebend, or airbend, draw a card' and is not summoning sick. A controls nine Islands and six Grizzly Bears, all untapped.

decisions: A casts Spirit Water Revival, choosing to pay the optional waterbend {6} by tapping the six Grizzly Bears, and pays {1}{U}{U} by tapping three Islands.
Avatar Aang's trigger resolves; both players pass and Spirit Water Revival resolves.

variants.label: paid_with_creatures
variants.expected: Avatar Aang's trigger fires when the cost is paid and A draws one card. Spirit Water Revival then resolves with its additional cost paid: A shuffles the graveyard into the library and draws seven cards, so A's hand holds eight cards, and Spirit Water Revival is exiled.

variants.label: paid_with_mana
variants.delta: A pays the waterbend {6} by tapping six more Islands instead of the Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: Avatar Aang's trigger fires and A draws one card. Spirit Water Revival resolves with its additional cost paid and A draws seven more, so A's hand holds eight cards. All nine Islands are tapped and the Grizzly Bears stay untapped.

variants.label: cost_declined
variants.delta: A does not pay the optional waterbend {6}.
variants.expected: Avatar Aang's trigger does not fire. Spirit Water Revival resolves without its additional cost paid and A draws two cards, so A's hand holds two cards. Spirit Water Revival is exiled.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge runs the Waterbend elemental-bend trigger from MagicStack whenever the spell ability has a maximum waterbend amount set, which may include a spell where the optional waterbend cost was declined.
